title: pnatlas: a multiscale reference of human peripheral nervous system cell states

creators.name: Lai, Kaitao
creators.affiliation: The University of Sydney; ANZAC Research Institute

description: Code, configuration, metadata, result tables and the static gene lookup site for pnatlas, which joins public single-cell data from human sensory and autonomic ganglia and peripheral nerve into one reference of cell states, places the states in tissue with Xenium and Visium sections, estimates them in GTEx tibial nerve, links them to inherited and acquired neuropathy genetics, and tests whether these features improve the PNPrank temporal back-test.
